title: Table condition
statement: Let $\mu,\mu':\mathbb N\to\mathbb Z$ and let $M_o,f_r,i$ be natural numbers. The table condition holds when, for every natural number $j<i$, $\mu'(f_r+j)=M_o2^j$, and the pair $(\mu,\mu')$ satisfies the relation called $\mathrm{Kept}$ at offset $f_r$.
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the relation $\mathrm{Kept}$, so its mathematical meaning cannot be rendered more explicitly.
